summary: Tested new barcode scan feature on backend (GET /api/scan/{code}, POST /api/scan/adjust) plus barcode field persistence on raw-items and finished-items. 12/12 tests pass against public URL. All scenarios in the review request verified: raw lookup, finished lookup, 404 with Italian message, positive/negative adjust, finished adjust, 404 on unknown, 401 unauthenticated for both endpoints, movement logged with 'Scan —' prefix, and barcode persistence on POST + GET of raw and finished items.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is approaching 800 lines — consider splitting routers (scan, bottling, auth) into modules for maintainability.
POST /scan/adjust allows negative deltas that could push quantity below 0; no guard for negative stock. Consider validating final quantity >= 0 or at least returning a warning.
ScanAdjustIn.quantity_delta has no bounds; a user error could overwrite stock drastically. Consider adding Field(gt=-100000, lt=100000) or similar sanity bounds.

Code trimming is done on GET but detail message in POST /scan/adjust uses the trimmed code only in 404 path — minor consistency; also code is not validated for empty string in POST (returns 404 instead of 400).
